assumptions: Counts are negative binomial with the pilot's per-gene mean and dispersion; the DE genes are a random `changed_fraction` of all genes, with log fold changes from PROPER's normal(0, 1.5) unless one is given.
Every experiment is analyzed with edgeR's classic pipeline (TMM, common then tagwise dispersion, exact test, Benjamini-Hochberg).
A pilot's parameters stand for the experiment to be run: same organism, tissue and protocol.
limits: The answer is a Monte-Carlo estimate: its standard error is reported, and more rounds narrow it.
Only edgeR's exact test is simulated; PROPER's DESeq2 and DSS arms are not run, and a lab using another pipeline sees a different power.
Depth re-weighting (power.seqDepth) reuses the stratified power at the simulated depth; after filtering PROPER misaligns it, which is reproduced and flagged.
bio.jane/contract.question: For a two-group RNA-seq experiment analyzed with edgeR, what power and false discovery rate does each number of replicates actually achieve, for genes at each expression level, and how would more sequencing depth change it?

description: Power and FDR for a two-group RNA-seq experiment by SIMULATION (PROPER 1.44.0): whole experiments drawn from a real pilot (Cheung, Gilad, Bottomly, MAQC, or a sequencing depth), each run through edgeR's exact test at every sample size. Reports power stratified by expression, the FDR actually achieved, true and false calls, and power at other depths; reproducible from its seed, value for value against R.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

call_by.description: call a gene by its FDR or its raw p-value. Values: fdr (FDR), pval (raw p-value).

changed_fraction.description: the proportion of genes that are differentially expressed.

cutoff.description: the cut-off a gene is called at.

depth_factors.description: sequencing depth multipliers to re-weight power to. Advanced.

dispersion.description: one dispersion (BCV²) for every gene, instead of the pilot's; left unset, the pilot's own. Advanced.

dispersion_pilot.description: take dispersions from this pilot instead (with a depth or a constant baseline, Cheung's unless set). Advanced.

dropped_strata.description: which strata (1-based) to drop. Only applies when filter_by is expr. Advanced.

filter_by.description: drop the lowest expression strata before counting, and recompute BH over what is left. Values: none (Keep every gene), expr (Drop low expression). Advanced.

log_fold_change.description: one log fold change for every DE gene; left unset, PROPER's normal(0, 1.5) draws. Advanced.

log_mean.description: the natural-log mean count every gene shares. Only applies when pilot is constant.

pilot.description: where each gene's baseline expression comes from: one of PROPER's pilots, a sequencing depth applied to aggregated human expression, or one constant. Values: cheung (Cheung (unrelated people, large dispersion)), gilad (Gilad (human liver, moderate)), bottomly (Bottomly (inbred mice, small)), maqc (MAQC (technical replicates)), depth (Sequencing depth), constant (One constant).

reads_per_sample.description: total reads per sample. Only applies when pilot is depth.

replicates.description: replicates per group at each sample size to evaluate.

rounds.description: simulated experiments. PROPER's own default is 100; each is a full edgeR run at every sample size, so time grows with it.

second_group.description: replicates in the second group at each size, when the groups differ. Advanced.

seed.description: the seed; round i uses seed + i, as PROPER does. Advanced.

strata.description: stratum break points; unset, PROPER's: 0, 10, 20, 40 … 1280, ∞ for expression. Advanced.

stratify_by.description: stratify the power by expression (mean normalized count) or by dispersion. Values: expr (Expression), dispersion (Dispersion). Advanced.

target.description: which DE genes count as worth finding: by |log fold change|, or by |log fold change| / √dispersion. Values: lfc (Log fold change), effectsize (Effect size).

threshold.description: the threshold a DE gene's size must exceed to count.

name: simulate_rnaseq_power

power.description: marginal power at each sample size

powerSE.description: the Monte-Carlo standard error of each marginal power

rScript.description: the R that reproduces the run

seqDepth.description: marginal power re-weighted to each sequencing depth factor, per sample size

strata.description: the stratum intervals the stratified readouts are over

stratifiedFDR.description: achieved FDR by stratum and sample size

stratifiedPower.description: power by expression (or dispersion) stratum, one line per sample size

summary.description: per sample size: nominal and achieved FDR (or type I error), marginal power, mean true and false discoveries, false discovery cost
